SEARCH
Package in.co.rays.proj4.controller

Interface ORSView

public interface ORSView
ORSView interface contains constants for application context, JSP view paths, controller URLs, and report file paths. These constants are used for navigation between different views and controllers in the ORS application.
Author:
karunaChouhan
